description: Antigravity lifecycle hooks template for workstation and project automation.
_comment: Place in .agents/hooks.json (workspace) or plugins/<name>/hooks.json. Set 'enabled: false' to keep inactive until needed.

command-safety-guard.description: PreToolUse hook to intercept run_command and prevent accidental execution of destructive patterns.

code-linter-formatter.description: PostToolUse hook to auto-format files or run linters after file modifications.

git-hygiene-reminder.description: PreInvocation hook to check working tree hygiene before agent execution begins.
